name: toolrouter-workflows
description: Specialist workflows and a persistent workspace in ChatGPT: website SEO audits, AI agent readiness, supply-chain risk, contract and grant matching, competitor and deep research, and more.

interface.longDescription:
Toolrouter turns specialist work into one plain-language request. Jobs that would normally need several specialist subscriptions, technical setup and hours of manual cross-checking become one ask: Toolrouter runs the multi-step workflow, combines the sources, and returns a finished result in the conversation.

Workflows include:
- Website SEO audit: crawls up to 100 pages and returns a scored report with a prioritised fix list, on Toolrouter's own analysis engine.
- AI agent readiness: about 14 checks of a website run in parallel and scored.
- Software supply-chain risk: OSV, GitHub advisories, CISA known-exploited vulnerabilities, EPSS, OpenSSF Scorecard and deps.dev combined into one risk score per package.
- Public contract and grant matching: official procurement and grant portals searched together and ranked against your organisation's profile.
- Competitor research and deep research reports, stock analysis, case-law citation maps, property planning constraints and record-collection valuation.

Your work persists in a Toolrouter workspace: saved prompts, personas, products and style references, a file library with permanent links, and long-running jobs with progress. Results render as tables, charts, maps and reports. Beyond the headline workflows, Toolrouter's wider catalogue of specialist tools is available in the same connection.
defaultPrompt: Audit the SEO of my website and list the top fixes
How ready is my website for AI agents?
Give me the analyst view on Apple stock

publication.release_notes: Headline workflows are now their own tools (website SEO audit, AI agent readiness, supply-chain risk, contract and grant matching, competitor and deep research, stock analysis, case citations, property constraints, collection valuation), each returning one finished result.

positive.description: Whole-site SEO audit with a prioritised fix list
positive.prompt: Run a Toolrouter website SEO audit on https://htmx.org and give me the top five fixes.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the Website SEO audit tool once and returns a scored report with technical, content and answer-engine findings, then summarises the five highest-priority fixes.

positive.description: AI agent readiness check of a public website
positive.prompt: Use Toolrouter to check how ready https://stripe.com is for AI agents.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the AI agent readiness check and returns an overall score with the individual checks (robots, sitemap, agent manifests, OpenAPI, OAuth) and what to fix first.

positive.description: Supply-chain risk for two npm packages
positive.prompt: With Toolrouter, check lodash 4.17.20 and minimist 1.2.5 on npm for supply-chain risk.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the supply-chain risk tool once with both packages and returns a ranked table with risk level, risk score and advisory counts for each.

positive.description: Analyst view of a listed stock
positive.prompt: Use Toolrouter to give me the analyst view on Apple (AAPL) stock.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the stock analysis tool once and returns the analyst rating, target price, valuation, short, intermediate and long-term outlook and support and resistance levels, then summarises them.

positive.prompt: Use Toolrouter to run a page SEO check on https://www.python.org and tell me what to fix.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the page SEO check once and returns the page score with title, meta description, headings, links and structured-data findings, then lists the fixes in priority order.

negative.prompt: Write me a haiku about autumn.

negative.description: Summarising pasted text needs no tool
negative.prompt: Summarise this paragraph: The meeting moved to Thursday because the venue was double-booked.
